correctness.rationale: Both characteristics have direct product tables and exhaustive block reductions: the right annihilator is intrinsic; in odd characteristic independent augmentation and parity forms kill extension blocks and enforce diagonal/antidiagonal scaling; in characteristic two the idempotent condition forces quotient permutation and the remaining extension block is free. Normal-form bijections give all and only automorphisms. Exhaustive GF(2) GL4 census and GF(4), GF(3), GF(5) independent checks reproduce the finite formulas. Computations are corroboration, not the infinite-field proof.

value.rationale: The canonical four-element even dihedral-quandle algebra lies in a currently partly classified family. The characteristic-two automorphism group acquires a four-dimensional unipotent additive normal subgroup absent in odd characteristic; over finite fields this changes the automorphism count from 2(q−1)^2 to 2q^4, already 32 versus 8 over GF(2) relative to underlying-quandle automorphisms. This is a complete structural classification across all fields, not a small enumerative increment.
